objective_1_quickedit.root_cause: Observed worker window title 'Select Administrator: Hermes Remote Worker ...' is the classic console mark/QuickEdit title prefix. In a classic Windows console, mark/select mode suspends the process on its next console write. The worker printed progress and its watchdog from the same thread, so both the worker and the 300s no-progress watchdog could be suspended while the dispatched task had already landed its commit.
objective_1_quickedit.mechanism: remote_queue/visible_worker.py: disable_quick_edit_for_this_console() opens this process's own console input buffer via CreateFileW("CONIN$"), reads the input mode, clears ENABLE_QUICK_EDIT_MODE (0x0040), ensures ENABLE_EXTENDED_FLAGS (0x0080), and verifies the result. Applied before the first progress line and before the Hermes child is launched.
scope_limits: worker window stays visible; CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE launch path unchanged
no global/registry console preference read or written
no AttachConsole/AllocConsole/FreeConsole/GetConsoleProcessList, no other process console touched (source-inspection test)
on failure the exact limitation is printed and the worker continues (stop condition honoured)
objective_1_quickedit.secondary_fix: Console output is serialised through a bounded writer thread (_ConsoleWriter) and the no-progress watchdog also runs in its own thread, terminating the Hermes child tree before it prints anything; both firing paths are idempotent. The in-loop watchdog backstop, 300s default, HERMES_REMOTE_IDLE_TIMEOUT override, exit code 124 and taskkill /PID <child> /T /F semantics are unchanged.

real_console_evidence.interpretation: 503 -> 439 is exactly the QuickEdit bit 0x40 cleared on a live console with all other input-mode bits preserved.
real_console_evidence.note: The probe changed only the probing process's own console instance (the Hermes terminal session console). No HKCU/registry value, shortcut property, or owner-level console preference was written.

objective_2_bounded_retry.unknown_category_behaviour: park (fail closed; transient cannot be proven)
objective_2_bounded_retry.bound: plan_retry() cannot return retry beyond MAX_ATTEMPTS, and poller._run_task_with_bounded_retry() additionally refuses to re-execute a task whose persisted budget is exhausted: no input can produce an unbounded loop.
objective_2_bounded_retry.audit_state: remote_queue/queue_schema.py record_execution_attempt() persists execution_attempts[] and retry_state{attempts_used, retries_used, max_attempts, max_retries, last_blocker_category, next_action, reason} on remote-queue/running/<task_id>.json before the next attempt and publishes it with the normal queue commit path; read_retry_state()/next_attempt_number() resume the same bounded count after a restart.
objective_2_bounded_retry.landed_work_preserved: Retries are labelled (visible console 'Attempt: N', dispatch --attempt) and the generated prompt gains a RETRY CONTEXT block instructing the agent to re-inspect repository/queue state, keep commits/evidence from earlier attempts, resume from the smallest unfinished unit, and report a genuine deterministic blocker instead of redoing work. The running task contract file is never rewritten.
objective_2_bounded_retry.stage2_anti_loop_rule: Unchanged and covered by a regression test: a blocked result with blocker_category=credentials parks on the first attempt.

key_regressions: test_watchdog_still_fires_and_records_124_while_console_writes_block: with the console sink deliberately blocked, the worker still kills the Hermes child, writes 124 to its exit file, writes no fabricated response, and returns in under 15s.
test_console_writer_never_blocks_its_caller_and_counts_drops: say() never blocks against a stalled console; drops are counted; the bounded drain always returns.
test_disables_quick_edit_on_this_console_only: exact mode write to this process's own handle, unrelated input modes preserved, handle closed; already-clean console not rewritten.
test_worker_reports_the_exact_limitation_when_no_console_exists: truthful UNAVAILABLE (no-console-attached) line, no write, worker still completes.
test_recoverable_failure_is_retried_twice_then_blocked: exactly attempts [1,2,3] then blocked with persisted/published retry metadata; never a fourth execution.
test_resume_continues_from_persisted_attempt_count / test_exhausted_persisted_budget_is_not_re_executed: resume keeps the bound; an exhausted budget never re-runs.
